messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduling config-only change in 11:30-12:00 UTC window. Diff summary: default_tenant_rps 450->300, request_timeout 17000ms->14000ms, routing_policy add 'latency-first' for eu-central, batching.max_tokens 1500->800, kv_prefix_ttl 700s->350s. Canary plan: 1% x 8m -> 5% x 12m -> 25% x 10m -> 100%. Auto-rollback: 5xx increase >0.5% abs OR p95 rise >1.5s OR sustained GPU util >88% for 5m.

deploy-bot: Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-config-1742703333

erin: ack. I'll watch p95/p99 and top endpoints. Note: halving kv ttl will likely increase eviction churn; prep an infra ticket.

sam: pinning canary to model-serving:v2.4.0 to avoid model routing flips. Excluding heavy tenants: batch-ingest, telemetry-export.

tariq: ops - please add exclusions and set up fast-rollback steps. Also raise trace sampling for canary.

ops: exclusions applied: ["batch-ingest","telemetry-export"]. Playbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/config-rollback-quick

sre-oncall: Alerts to add: p95>1s warn, p95>1.5s critical; 5xx>0.25% warn, 5xx>0.5% critical; kvcache_evictions > baseline+10% warn.

deploy-bot: Starting 1% canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary 1% active.

erin: 2m in: p95 390ms, 5xx 0.01%, kvcache_evictions +3%. No red flags.

sam: model pin confirmed.

deploy-bot: 1% window complete. Metrics green. Promoting to 5% for 12m.

deploy-bot: 5% active.

erin: at 5% (4m): p95 510ms, 5xx 0.02%, evictions +9%. Keep watching the eviction curve.

sre-oncall: eviction +9% noted. No OOMs. Traces show slightly more redis calls per request.

ops: kicked off INF-619: kvcache-ttl-eval and warmup preseed task.

deploy-bot: 5% hold completed; all within thresholds. Rolling to 25%.

deploy-bot: 25% active.

erin: immediate ramp blip: p95 -> 1.0s for ~90s then settled at 620ms. No 5xx increase.

sre-oncall: observed transient GPU util bump to 80% on two pods during ramp; no sustained breach.

sam: continue but prepare to rollback if p95 stays >1s for 3m.

deploy-bot: Holding at 25% per request for 6m.

erin: after hold p95 stable ~640ms, evictions +13%. Still below critical.

deploy-bot: Proceeding to 100% now. Change window open until 12:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% applied.

erin: 5m post-roll: p95 670ms, 5xx 0.03%, kvcache_evictions +14%, token_cost_unit +1.9%. No rollback triggers hit.

sre-oncall: continuing 30m elevated monitoring. No alerts fired.

ops: release notes updated with outcome and followups: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-config-1742703333#notes. INF-619 linked.

sam: leaving the model pin in place for 24h. We'll unpin after stability confirmed.

tariq: follow-ups: consider intermediate kv ttl (e.g., 500s) in next patch and add a warmup preseed for new nodes.

erin: no objections. Thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Thread closed. If regressions appear, run the rollback playbook or escalate to #eng-oncall.
